findings.summary: The confined evaluator artifact port closes the prior authority leak: callers receive only a frozen prepare operation, while recording and provider capabilities remain separately declared.
findings.broken_invariant: No invariant is broken; evaluator preparation is confined to canonical evidence-packet creation without exposing CommandContext, task mutation, Git mutation, generic file writes, approvals, or provider execution.

evidence_refs.section: EvaluatorArtifactPreparationPort implementation, capability profiles, registry dispatch, and denial tests

hidden_assumptions: The existing task-loading and evaluator-review preparation layers continue to enforce canonical task paths and safe artifact publication beneath the resolved repository root.
